headline: Approved a letter commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro for their heroic action; approved August minutes and department reports.
summary: Members approved the August 18 meeting minutes and the August department reports. They voted unanimously to send a letter commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro for aiding victims after a garbage truck crashed into the Pequabuck River. A property owner at 20-22 Union Street asked for a payment arrangement on a high water and sewer bill and was asked to write a letter.
decisions: Approved the August 18, 2026 regular meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved the August 2026 department reports, unanimously.
Approved sending a letter commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro for their heroic action, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of Commissioner Cunningham and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 18, 2026 regular meeting minutes as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 2026 Department Reports as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Cunningham and seconded; it was unanimously voted to send a letter on behalf of the Board commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro for their heroic action.

decision_titles: Letter commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro
